verdict.rationale: Tailscale provides an encrypted mesh network that lets users SSH into remote hosts (docs-7, comm-1) and community reports using it for file transfers (comm-7 mentions Samba transfers), implying scp/sftp would work the same way over the tailnet since it's just standard networking with normal SSH keys. However, no evidence explicitly confirms scp/sftp usage, and there are noted performance caveats for file transfers over the network (comm-7, comm-10).
